programs.name: suimp2d
programs.purpose: Generate shot records for a line scatterer using a three-dimensional Born response.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUIMP2D - generate shot records for a line scatterer
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Sinc interpolation, FFT ordering, square roots, float/double mixing and header rounding affect exact results. A source or receiver at the scatterer causes division by zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines sinc interpolation and FFT-based spectral shaping for each generated trace.

test_cases.command: suimp2d nt=128 dt=0.004 nshot=2 nrec=4 x0=200 z0=200 c=2000

test_cases.description: Vertical receiver geometry and signed offsets.
test_cases.command: suimp2d nt=128 nshot=1 nrec=4 dgx=0 dgz=25 dsz=25 x0=200 z0=200 c=2000

programs.name: suimp3d
programs.purpose: Generate in-plane shot records for a point scatterer using a three-dimensional Born response.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUIMP3D - generate inplane shot records for a point

params.name: dir
params.description: Set to 1 to add a direct arrival.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Sinc interpolation, FFT ordering, square roots and float/double mixing affect exact results. The direct arrival divides by horizontal source-receiver distance, which is zero for coincident horizontal positions; i*i can overflow for sufficiently large FFTs.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines sinc interpolation and FFT-based spectral shaping with optional direct arrivals.

test_cases.description: Point scatterer with multiple shots and receivers.
test_cases.command: suimp3d nt=128 nshot=2 nrec=4 x0=200 y0=50 z0=200 c=2000

test_cases.description: Direct arrival with nonzero source-receiver separation.
test_cases.command: suimp3d nt=128 nrec=4 gxmin=50 dgx=25 dir=1 x0=200 z0=200 c=2000

programs.license_note: Credits Chris Liner of the University of Houston with adding the direct-arrival option.

programs.name: sukdsyn2d
programs.purpose: Generate common-shot seismic traces from a migrated section and traveltime tables by Kirchhoff depth synthesis.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUKDSYN2D - Kirchhoff Depth SYNthesis of 2D seismic data from a

params.name: infile
params.description: Binary-float migrated section; input must be seekable.

params.name: outfile
params.description: SU output file; output must be seekable.

params.name: ns
params.description: Number of traveltime table source positions.

params.name: ls
params.description: Nonzero for a line source; zero for a point source.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT integration, interpolation, depth and lateral accumulation order, convolution, square roots, logarithms and float/double mixing affect exact results. Some amplitude arrays are only partially initialized before interpolation, so certain geometries can read uninitialized values. Input fread counts are not checked.
programs.difficulty_reason: Kirchhoff synthesis combines traveltime-table interpolation, spatial integration, anti-aliasing and convolution across multiple buffered grids.

test_cases.description: Small line-source synthesis with zero-valued section and tables; redirect output to a seekable file.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=8 ntr=4 | sustrip > mig.bin && sunull nt=8 ntr=8 | sustrip > tt.bin && sukdsyn2d infile=mig.bin outfile=out.su ttfile=tt.bin nt=128 dt=0.004 nxs=2 dxs=10 nxo=1 nxt=4 fxt=0 dxt=10 nzt=8 fzt=10 dzt=10 ns=2 fs=0 ds=10 nx=4 fx=0 dx=10 nz=8 fz=10 dz=10 ls=1

test_cases.description: Point-source synthesis with a vertical velocity gradient.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=8 ntr=4 | sustrip > mig.bin && sunull nt=8 ntr=8 | sustrip > tt.bin && sukdsyn2d infile=mig.bin outfile=out.su ttfile=tt.bin nt=128 dt=0.004 nxs=1 nxo=2 dxo=10 nxt=4 fxt=0 dxt=10 nzt=8 fzt=10 dzt=10 ns=2 fs=0 ds=10 nx=4 fx=0 dx=10 nz=8 fz=10 dz=10 ls=0 dvz=0.5 angmax=45

programs.name: sunhmospike
programs.purpose: Generate a common-CDP spike gather with selectable nonhyperbolic moveout.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUNHMOSPIKE - generates SPIKE test data set with a choice of several

params.name: gopt
params.description: Moveout function: 1 parabolic, 2 pseudo-hyperbolic, 3 linear, 4 absolute offset.

params.name: offinc
params.description: Offset increment; first offset equals this value.

params.name: refdepth
params.description: Reference depth for gopt=2; selfdoc calls this depthref.

params.name: depthref
params.description: Selfdoc-only spelling; the code does not read this parameter.

params.name: nspk
params.description: Number of enabled events, up to four.

params.name: p1
params.description: Event 1 moveout in milliseconds at reference offset.

params.name: p2
params.description: Event 2 moveout in milliseconds at reference offset.

params.name: p3
params.description: Event 3 moveout in milliseconds at reference offset.

params.name: p4
params.description: Event 4 moveout in milliseconds at reference offset; selfdoc says 120.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Moveout uses float arithmetic, double-valued constants and sqrt; conversion to integer truncates sample positions. Coincident events accumulate in event order, and zero reference moveout denominator can cause division by zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: Each trace places up to four calculated spikes using simple moveout formulas.

test_cases.description: Parabolic moveout with custom event amplitudes.
test_cases.command: sunhmospike nt=256 ntr=8 dt=0.001 gopt=1 nspk=2 p2=80 a2=0.5
sunhmospike nt=256 ntr=8 gopt=2 refdepth=300 offref=1000 offinc=100 p2=50
sunhmospike nt=256 ntr=8 gopt=4 offinc=-100 offref=1000 p4=50

programs.license_note: Credits identify John Anderson as a visitor from Mobil.

programs.name: suplane
programs.purpose: Generate a common-offset gather containing up to three dipping planes.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPLANE - create common offset data file with up to 3 planes

params.name: npl
params.description: Number of planes; plane 1 is always generated.

params.name: taper
params.description: Set to 1 to taper plane ends.

params.name: dip1
params.description: Plane 1 dip in milliseconds per trace.

params.name: dip2
params.description: Plane 2 dip in milliseconds per trace.

params.name: dip3
params.description: Plane 3 dip in milliseconds per trace.

params.name: liner
params.description: Set to 1 to override dimensions and plane geometry with the 64-by-64 example.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Fractional sample interpolation and sequential accumulation and tapering of overlapping planes depend on float rounding. The bounds check permits fit equal to nt and writes itmore beyond the requested trace samples; near the maximum trace capacity this can exceed the data array.
programs.difficulty_reason: It generates each trace using direct linear interpolation of up to three planes.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 npl=2 taper=1 dip1=2 dip2=-3 len1=10 len2=8 ct1=50 ct2=80

programs.name: suremac2d
programs.purpose: Model two-dimensional acoustic wave propagation using Fourier spatial derivatives and rapid expansion time integration.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUREMAC2D - Acoustic 2D Fourier method modeling with high accuracy

params.name: opflag
params.description: Wave equation: 0 variable density, 1 constant density, 2 non-reflecting.

params.name: nx
params.description: Horizontal grid size; must be a valid PFA length.

params.name: nz
params.description: Vertical grid size; must be a valid PFA length.

params.name: isz
params.description: Vertical source grid indices; count must equal isx count.

params.name: sflag
params.description: Source time function: 0 file, 1 spike, 2 Ricker.

params.name: fmax
params.description: Maximum Ricker frequency; required when sflag=2. With other sflag values the code still uses it in a sampling check even if omitted.

params.name: prec
params.description: Bessel coefficient mode: 0 compute, 1 compute and write b_k, 2 read b_k.

params.name: irz
params.description: Vertical grid indices of horizontal receiver lines; absent means no horizontal section.

params.name: irx
params.description: Horizontal grid indices of vertical receiver lines; absent means no vertical section.

params.name: vmaxu
params.description: User-specified maximum velocity; zero uses the model maximum.

params.name: amps
params.description: Source amplitudes; supplied values overwrite the initial array.

params.name: densfile
params.description: Binary-float density model file, read for opflag=0.

params.name: sname
params.description: Input SU wavelet file for sflag=0.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT derivatives, Bessel recurrence and numerical integration, repeated expansion-term accumulation, float/double mixing and transcendental functions are sensitive to operation order and platform math. fmax is uninitialized when omitted with sflag other than 2 but is still used; the odd-grid checks use !nx % 2 and !nz % 2, which do not enforce the documented condition. Very small expansion counts can cause out-of-bounds coefficient access.
programs.difficulty_reason: The long wave-equation solver combines Fourier derivatives, Bessel coefficient integration, iterative expansion and multi-dimensional output buffering.

test_cases.description: Constant-density Ricker source with horizontal receiver line and snapshots.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=25 ntr=25 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.bin && suremac2d opflag=1 nx=25 nz=25 nt=64 dx=10 dz=10 dt=0.004 isx=12 isz=12 fmax=30 irz=12 dtsnap=0.032 iabso=0 velfile=vel.bin sepxname=sectx.su snpname=snap.su

test_cases.description: Variable-density spike source with vertical receiver line.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=25 ntr=25 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.bin && sunull nt=25 ntr=25 | sugain bias=1000 | sustrip > dens.bin && suremac2d opflag=0 nx=25 nz=25 nt=64 dx=10 dz=10 dt=0.004 isx=12 isz=12 sflag=1 fmax=30 irx=12 iabso=0 w=2 velfile=vel.bin densfile=dens.bin sepzname=sectz.su
